subject: bindinfo, planner: reuse binding normalization for plan cache key (#66053)
summary: Planner change switches `NewPlanCacheKey` to call the new `bindinfo.MatchSQLBindingWithCache` with `&PlanCacheStmt.BindingInfo`, reusing `NormalizeStmtForBinding`/`CollectTableNames` results across executions without changing match semantics. No Blocker/High issues found in planner behavior; no follow-up changes to `pkg/planner/core/plan_cache_utils.go` or `pkg/bindinfo/binding.go` up to `upstream/master`.
